verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of registration-time device attestation, such as FIDO2 attestation certificates, AAGUIDs or metadata, that a relying party could verify to admit only genuine, approved Nitrokey models. The one community mention of attestation certs concerns exporting HSM key attestation through a vendor shell. That is a different capability and does not show enrollment-time model enforcement.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can verify device attestation at registration to enforce that only genuine, approved key models are enrolled
